root_idea.summary: The root centers on elevation, height, and being raised above or made prominent.
root_idea.development: From physical height and upward movement it extends to visibility, eminence, superiority, upper coverings and the sky; the noun اِسْمٌ is explained as a designation that raises its referent into notice.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Normalized to the Form II perfect citation form سَمَّى.
Displayed as the passive participle citation form مُسَمًّى.
Displayed as the singular noun سَمَاءٌ, while retaining its Quranic singular and plural usage.
Displayed as the pure verbal noun تَسْمِيَةٌ.

senses.definition: To name, call, or designate someone or something by a name or description.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses the verb for assigning names and for polemical designations whose claimed referents or attributes may be denied; the object may be a person, group, or supposed deity.

senses.definition: Named, designated, or fixed by designation; specified or appointed.
senses.usage_conditions: It commonly qualifies a term, time, period, or other matter whose identity or limit has been assigned or determined.

senses.definition: The sky or heaven; the elevated expanse above the earth, including the heavens as a collective or plural.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses the noun in both singular and plural/collective expression, including the seven heavens; grammatical gender and number vary by construction.

senses.definition: A namesake: one who bears the same name.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic discussion of Yahya, the term denies a prior namesake in the relevant naming relationship, rather than merely denying that anyone anywhere could share a label.

senses.definition: An equal, peer, or counterpart genuinely sharing a name or attribute.
senses.usage_conditions: In the question concerning God, the term means a counterpart deserving the same name or description in truth, not simply someone who happens to be called by a similar word.

senses.definition: Naming or designating; the act of assigning a name or description.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction, it refers specifically to their assigning a feminine designation to the angels, treating that designation as a claim about their status.

senses.definition: A name or designation by which a thing, person, quality, or concept is known and distinguished.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran applies it to names in the ordinary sense, to linguistic designations together with what they identify, and in بسم الله and related phrases to invoking or acting under the name of the named deity. Polemical passages may describe names as empty designations when their claimed referents or qualities are absent.

senses.definition: A divine name understood as an attribute or title expressing a real perfection or quality.
senses.usage_conditions: In references to the divine names, the name is not treated as a bare label: its meaning is connected with the quality it truthfully expresses, such as knowledge, mercy, or generosity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise, become high, or be elevated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The basic intransitive verb of height and upward movement; it may be used of a person or a thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise into view so as to become clearly distinguishable from a distance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a visible form or figure that becomes perceptible to an observer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise and hasten toward someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A directional construction with لِ or a comparable complement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the eye or gaze to rise; figuratively, to have a lofty or proud look.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The literal use concerns sight or the eye; the proud or haughty sense is figurative.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be high or eminent in rank, aspire to eminence, or exceed a number.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The branch extends from physical height to social distinction, ambition, and being above a stated quantity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a longing or yearning to arise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of rising applied to an inward desire or emotion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go out in pursuit of game or watch for wild animals to emerge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A hunting usage describing the hunter's seeking or watching for quarry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a stallion to spring upon or overpower his she-camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized pastoral use, associated with she-camels beyond the stated period after giving birth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pronounce or invoke the name of God over an act, object, food, or animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional religious construction, especially before eating or before an animal is slaughtered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vie, compete, or contend with another for superiority, eminence, glory, or excellence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form III construction is reciprocal or comparative and may be used of a contest in rank or distinction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To raise, elevate, exalt, or cause someone or something to go up or away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The causative Form IV may describe raising an object or making someone go up from a town or country.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incite someone to hunt or chase.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized causative hunting use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To look at or toward the visible form or aspect of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is its سَمَاوَة, the form or appearance seen from a distance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take the direction of or come to a named place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of going toward a particular locality, including the desert region called al-Samāwah.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To name oneself, become named, or be called by a name.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may be reflexive or quasi-passive: something becomes the person's name or designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To claim relationship to a people by adopting or asserting a name of affiliation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a group or people to assert attachment or descent by name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mount upon horses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural or reciprocal usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vie or compete with one another for superiority or eminence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reciprocal Form VI usage; the competition may concern glory or excellence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To call one another by their names.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal naming construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wear or ask to borrow the protective socks used by a hunter on hot ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The item is the مِسْمَاة, worn for hunting gazelles during intense heat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hunt or pursue wild animals, especially gazelles in their hiding places.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized hunting use associated with seeking game at an unusual time or season.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone the object of a visit, or to perceive goodness in someone from outward signs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Two related reported uses of the Form VIII verb: visiting a person and discerning good by an informed judgment of appearances.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To choose, prefer, or select something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported Form VIII usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: According to one reported usage, to test a young she-camel for pregnancy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This interpretation is attributed to one authority and explicitly rejected by another, who reads the word as تُسْتَمْنَى; it is retained as a disputed Classical report.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask or demand someone's name.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be the person whose name is requested.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The higher, upper, or highest part of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general spatial use, distinct from the conventional noun for the sky.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An overhead canopy, covering, ceiling, or roof.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may describe the covering over a person or the roof of a house, chamber, tent, or other structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The upper or overhead strip of cloth in a tent, including the piece beneath the top strip.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized tent-making term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cloud or clouds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The designation is explained by the height of clouds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transferred use based on rain coming from the sky or clouds; it may be grammatically masculine or feminine according to the analysis.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bounty or a gift from someone's store of generosity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An explicitly figurative extension from rain as a source of provision.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Herbage or pasture produced by rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or transferred use derived from rain as the cause of vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The back of a horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in opposition to the lower or ground-facing part, by reference to height.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The upper surface of a sandal on which the foot rests.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical use contrasted with the lower surface.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The form, figure, or aspect of something seen from a distance, especially a high or elevated outline.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may describe the visible shape of the new moon or another elevated object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of or relating to the sky or heaven; heavenly or celestial.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective derived from سَمَاءٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: High or lofty; figuratively, proud, haughty, or disdainful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It can describe people, animals, or a raised gaze and may be used figuratively for pride.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hunters going out to pursue game.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun is a substantivized epithet; some reports restrict it to daytime hunters or to hunters wearing the protective مِسْمَاة socks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fame, renown, report, or reputation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of a name into the public standing associated with a person, especially in a favorable sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Relating to a name, noun, or substantive; nominal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective is also used in grammatical terminology, as in a nominal sentence or phrase.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sock or stocking worn by a hunter to protect against burning ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized hunting article used in hot conditions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The best or most distinguished member of a people or party.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Classical expression, distinct from the Quranic passive-participle sense of being named or designated.

cautions: سَمَاءٌ has both singular and collective/plural Quranic usage; contextual renderings such as “rain from the sky” do not by themselves establish a separate Quranic rain sense.
The Quranic use of سَمِيٌّ concerns a genuine namesake, equal, or counterpart in the relevant name or attribute, not merely anyone sharing a verbal label.
The reported Form VIII pregnancy-testing sense is disputed in the cited Classical evidence.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The unattributed suggestion in lane-unit:smw:42258:g1:main that تَسَمَّى means “became high” is materially lexical but lacks supporting authority in the supplied passage, so it remains unresolved rather than being presented as a Classical meaning.
